authorization: An expired Management Key was presented
origin: message string copied verbatim from the management-key guide
notes: Management-key expiry is fixed at creation and cannot be changed; once it passes, every request fails this way and the key still appears on the settings page until it is deleted. Distinct from the missing-header 401 ('Missing Authentication header'): here a credential was presented and was rejected as stale, which is a needs-credentials state the user can act on, not a transport failure and not a zero balance. Expired keys still appear in the console, so a connection can look configured while every query fails.
